scope: Holo support in the app's managed llama.cpp runtime, with retained-worker native document verification
repair: Typed Holo inputs select Holo's model/projector names and request alias. The signed bundled executable and installer/test asset verification remain separate from runtime path-shape admission.

Fara and Holo use one launch argument path for their shared 8K context, image/batch limits, private API-key file, loopback-only transport and one-worker process policy. Each retains its own request builder, decoder and active-endpoint family checks.

Holo activation uses the existing serialized model owner, generation-scoped cancellation, join-before-replacement lifecycle, resource reporting and cleanup. Cached activation reuses the same endpoint.
Wrong model/projector/executable paths and physical memory below 12 GiB reject before launch. Holo and Fara default to the unchanged 4 GiB worker ceiling.

The standard runtime constructor now accepts a launcher while keeping its real loopback port, token, HTTP and resource implementations. The Foundation launcher is internal so an opt-in XCTest wrapper can change only the worker ceiling to 5 GiB and delegate actual launch, identity, monitoring and join behavior.

The native document test hashes both pinned Holo data files, verifies the signed verification-host runtime path, and reuses the managed runtime across proposals. No Python diagnostic worker executes this trial.

verification.finalBuild: The managed diagnostic launcher and native fixture workflow compile; three Holo lifecycle methods pass.
verification.errorAndRegressionChecks: Three invalid request/response scenarios stop and join Holo before Fara replacement and remove credentials. Three Fara lifecycle/resource methods and native exact Unicode/simulated login/Resume pass after the final source build.
verification.managedTaskOracle: Four proposals, including one wait, produce exactly two native wheel events and reveal the correct code. Horizontal position stays zero; the fixture remains open/frontmost, terminal replay emits no input, one managed worker serves the task and exits on requested shutdown.
verification.sourceTiming: The real managed trial used the final executable production behavior. Later changes add an error-path test and correct a comment; the final regression attempt recompiles the current source.
